title: EXploring Patients prioritiEs on outCome following Transcatheter valve interventions
summary:
Structured analysis of patients' individual expectations regarding clinical changes after clinically indicated transcatheter valve interventions for the aortic, mitral, or tricuspid valve, before and six weeks after the intervention.

The hypothesis is that patients primarily wish to improve their quality of life, while the central medical and scientific objective often focuses on improving patient mortality.

interventions.name: Enrollment will include consecutive patients who are clinically indicated for a transcatheter valve intervention (TAVI, M-TEER, T-TEER).
